headline: Quantum Advances & Mineral Detectors for Astroparticle Physics
summary: Today's literature features groundbreaking theoretical and experimental quantum physics papers, spanning hardware improvements, error correction, and quantum foundations. Additionally, a new study explores geological crystal detectors for neutrinos and dark matter.

themes.title: Quantum Hardware and Simulation
themes.body: Recent progress in quantum processors includes achieving ultra-low-power EDSR in germanium spin qubits with high fidelity, and introducing locally optimized variational evolution algorithms tested on Quantinuum and IBM hardware.

themes.title: Quantum Error Correction and Information
themes.body: Theoretical breakthroughs in quantum coding theory present explicit families of asymptotically good quantum locally testable codes with constant rate and distance, alongside new SDP formulations for parallel quantum channel discrimination.

themes.title: Quantum Foundations and Causal Structures
themes.body: Studies explore environmental alignment in imperfect CNOT quantum models and resolve an open question by proving that all causally separable quantum processes are circuits with classical control of causal order.

themes.title: Astroparticle Detection via Minerals
themes.body: Proceedings from the MDvDM'26 meeting highlight the emerging concept of using natural and synthetic crystals to record nuclear recoils from reactor neutrinos and dark matter over geological timescales.

connections.body: Both papers address optimization and fidelity in multi-qubit or complex quantum setups, utilizing numerical modeling and hardware implementations to advance quantum control.
